name: @kasarlabs/vesu-mcp

tools.name: deposit_earn
tools.description: Deposit tokens to earn yield on Vesu protocol

depositTokenSymbol.description: Symbol of the token to deposit (e.g., 'ETH', 'USDC')

depositAmount.description: The amount to deposit in human decimal format (e.g., "1.5" for 1.5 tokens, "0.0001" for 0.0001 tokens)

poolId.description: Optional pool ID. If not provided, GENESIS_POOLID will be used

tools.name: withdraw_earn
tools.description: Withdraw tokens from earning position on Vesu protocol

withdrawTokenSymbol.description: Symbol of the token to withdraw (e.g., 'ETH', 'USDC')

withdrawAmount.description: Optional amount to withdraw in human decimal format (e.g., "1.5" for 1.5 tokens). If "0" or not provided, withdraws all available tokens

poolId.description: Optional pool ID. If not provided, GENESIS_POOLID will be used

tools.name: deposit_multiply
tools.description: Deposit collateral and borrow debt to create or increase a multiply position on Vesu protocol v2

collateralTokenSymbol.description: Symbol of the collateral token to deposit (e.g., 'ETH', 'USDC')

debtTokenSymbol.description: Symbol of the debt token to borrow (e.g., 'ETH', 'USDC')

depositAmount.description: Amount of collateral to deposit in human decimal format (e.g., "1.5" for 1.5 tokens)

targetLTV.description: Target LTV (Loan-to-Value) ratio as a percentage (e.g., "75" for 75%). This is mandatory

poolId.description: Optional pool ID. If not provided, GENESIS_POOLID will be used

ekuboFee.description: Optional Ekubo pool fee tier as a percentage (e.g., 0.05 for 0.05%, 0.3 for 0.3%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.05)

ekuboTickSpacing.description: Optional Ekubo pool tick spacing as a percentage (e.g., 0.01 for 0.01%, 0.1 for 0.1%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.1)

ekuboExtension.description: Optional Ekubo pool extension contract address (default: "0x0")

ekuboSlippage.description: Optional slippage tolerance in basis points (e.g., 50 for 0.5%, 100 for 1%, defaults to 50 for 0.5%)

tools.name: withdraw_multiply
tools.description: Withdraw collateral and repay debt to decrease or close a multiply position on Vesu protocol v2

collateralTokenSymbol.description: Symbol of the collateral token to withdraw (e.g., 'ETH', 'USDC')

debtTokenSymbol.description: Symbol of the debt token to repay (e.g., 'ETH', 'USDC')

withdrawAmount.description: Optional amount of collateral to withdraw in human decimal format (e.g., "1.5" for 1.5 tokens). If "0" or not provided, closes the entire position

poolId.description: Optional pool ID. If not provided, GENESIS_POOLID will be used

ekuboFee.description: Optional Ekubo pool fee tier as a percentage (e.g., 0.05 for 0.05%, 0.3 for 0.3%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.05)

ekuboTickSpacing.description: Optional Ekubo pool tick spacing as a percentage (e.g., 0.01 for 0.01%, 0.1 for 0.1%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.1)

ekuboExtension.description: Optional Ekubo pool extension contract address (default: "0x0")

ekuboSlippage.description: Optional slippage tolerance in basis points (e.g., 50 for 0.5%, 100 for 1%, defaults to 50 for 0.5%)

tools.name: update_multiply
tools.description: Update the LTV (Loan-to-Value) ratio of an existing multiply position on Vesu protocol v2 without depositing or withdrawing collateral. This will automatically increase or decrease the debt to reach the target LTV.

collateralTokenSymbol.description: Symbol of the collateral token in the position (e.g., 'ETH', 'USDC')

debtTokenSymbol.description: Symbol of the debt token in the position (e.g., 'ETH', 'USDC')

targetLTV.description: Target LTV (Loan-to-Value) ratio as a percentage (e.g., "75" for 75%). This is mandatory and will update the position to this LTV

poolId.description: Optional pool ID. If not provided, GENESIS_POOLID will be used

ekuboFee.description: Optional Ekubo pool fee tier as a percentage (e.g., 0.05 for 0.05%, 0.3 for 0.3%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.05)

ekuboTickSpacing.description: Optional Ekubo pool tick spacing as a percentage (e.g., 0.01 for 0.01%, 0.1 for 0.1%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.1)

ekuboExtension.description: Optional Ekubo pool extension contract address (default: "0x0")

ekuboSlippage.description: Optional slippage tolerance in basis points (e.g., 50 for 0.5%, 100 for 1%, defaults to 50 for 0.5%)

tools.name: deposit_borrow
tools.description: Deposit collateral and borrow debt to create or increase a borrow position on Vesu protocol v2

collateralTokenSymbol.description: Symbol of the collateral token to deposit (e.g., 'ETH', 'USDC')

debtTokenSymbol.description: Symbol of the debt token to borrow (e.g., 'ETH', 'USDC')

depositAmount.description: Amount of collateral to deposit in human decimal format (e.g., "1.5" for 1.5 tokens)

targetLTV.description: Target LTV (Loan-to-Value) ratio as a percentage (e.g., "75" for 75%). This is mandatory

poolId.description: Optional pool ID. If not provided, GENESIS_POOLID will be used

tools.name: repay_borrow
tools.description: Repay debt without withdrawing collateral to decrease debt in a borrow position on Vesu protocol v2

debtTokenSymbol.description: Symbol of the debt token to repay (e.g., 'ETH', 'USDC')

repayAmount.description: Optional amount of debt to repay in human decimal format (e.g., "1.5" for 1.5 tokens). If not provided, repays all debt

poolId.description: Optional pool ID. If not provided, GENESIS_POOLID will be used

tools.name: get_pools
tools.description: Retrieves all the pools in the protocol with their information, like assets, stats, configs on Vesu protocol

onlyVerified.description: Filter to only show verified pools

onlyEnabledAssets.description: Filter to only show pools with enabled assets

poolId.description: Optional pool ID to fetch a specific pool

poolName.description: Optional pool name to filter pools by name

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description: Retrieves positions for a given wallet address on Vesu protocol. Can filter by type (earn, borrow, multiply), max health factor, and rebalancing status

walletAddress.description: Wallet address to fetch positions for

type.description: Optional array of position types to filter (earn, borrow, multiply)

maxHealthFactor.description: Optional filter to return positions with health factor less than or equal to this value

hasRebalancingEnabled.description: Optional filter to return positions that have rebalancing enabled or not

tools.name: get_tokens
tools.description: Retrieves all the supported tokens in Vesu UI. Can optionally filter by token address or symbol to check if a specific token is supported

address.description: Optional token address to check if a specific token is supported

symbol.description: Optional token symbol to check if a specific token is supported (e.g., 'ETH', 'USDC')
